question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

At one’s fingertips
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. To have complete knowledge.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"at one's fingertips"** means to have complete knowledge or easy access to something. (पूरी जानकारी होना या आसानी से उपलब्ध होना)

 
 
• **Example: **She has all the data at her fingertips, making her the most efficient analyst in the team.
 
 
 
• **"Complete knowledge"** implies having all the information about a subject. (पूर्ण ज्ञान)
 
 
• **Example: **He has complete knowledge of the company's operations, making him indispensable.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is:** To have complete knowledge**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: To be unaware of something** (किसी चीज़ से अनजान होना)

 
 
• **Example:** He seemed to be unaware of the changes happening in the office.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Out of reach** (पहुंच से बाहर)
 
 
• **Example:** The goal seemed out of reach, but they kept trying.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: To take revenge** (बदला लेना)
 
 
• **Example:** He was determined to take revenge for the wrong done to him.
